heading: Authorization of appropriations

tree.heading: Gallaudet University
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated such sums as may be necessary for each of the fiscal years 2009 through 2014 to carry out the provisions of subchapter I and this subchapter, relating to—

children.text: the Model Secondary School for the Deaf.

tree.heading: National Technical Institute for the Deaf
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated such sums as may be necessary for each of the fiscal years 2009 through 2014 to carry out the provisions of subchapter I and this subchapter relating to the National Technical Institute for the Deaf.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: Provisions similar to this section were contained in section 4360 of this title, prior to repeal by Pub. L. 105–244.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2008—Subsec. (a). Pub. L. 110–315, § 914(1), substituted “fiscal years 2009 through 2014” for “fiscal years 1998 through 2003” in introductory provisions. Subsec. (b). Pub. L. 110–315, § 914(2), substituted “fiscal years 2009 through 2014” for “fiscal years 1998 through 2003”.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective Oct. 1, 1998, except as otherwise provided in Pub. L. 105–244, see section 3 of Pub. L. 105–244, set out as an Effective Date of 1998 Amendment note under section 1001 of this title.

sourceCredit: (Pub. L. 99–371, title II, § 212, as added Pub. L. 105–244, title IX, § 925, Oct. 7, 1998, 112 Stat. 1833; amended Pub. L. 110–315, title IX, § 914, Aug. 14, 2008, 122 Stat. 3455.)
